configuration.order: Counts ascending, then training seeds ascending; rotate the four variants by (count_index+seed_index) modulo four. Across the twenty count/seed groups each variant appears in each position five times.
configuration.performance_scope: Python/PyTorch reference implementation, exact-event baseline kernels, real sampled RR events, full task loop and model-only timing separately.
configuration.units: Independent policy states and task ledgers in one CPU batch with shared checkpoint weights; not Hepta Cells.

decision: Retain every architecture, every training seed and all four actual scales. Use two warmup plus five measured complete episodes per condition to bound measurement runtime. No fastest-seed selection.

planning_only_extrapolation.method: Episode cost linear in policy count; a planning approximation, not measured scale performance. Ignores process startup, cache and allocation nonlinearities, and training-dependent dynamics.

tail_qualification: Five complete-episode samples and fifty-five inner batched calls per condition provide descriptive p95/p99 values only, without precise tail or SLA inference. Every reported production scale will be actually executed; planning extrapolations are not scale measurements.
